verdict.rationale: The evidence pack includes Teams Export APIs for exporting chat/channel messages, but nothing documents an audit log of admin and user actions across the workspace (e.g., admin center audit trail, sign-in/action logs). This is an applicable enterprise-compliance axis for a SaaS collaboration platform, but no evidence demonstrates it. Missing for 10: any documentation of an audit log feature, admin action tracking, or audit log search/export API distinct from content export.
